name: fallen green oak stick
description: a small, fallen, green stick with reddish-brown bark
details: A small, slender stick, snapped from the canopy above, its ends broken and frayed.  Its reddish-brown bark is hairless and dotted with pale lenticels, and a few small, blunt, reddish-brown buds cluster near its tip.  The wood is still green and bends rather than breaking.
keywords: fallen green oak stick small stick fallen stick green stick reddish-brown bark pale lenticels blunt reddish-brown buds green wood
